## Core Services
1. **Custom Web Experiences**: High-converting Next.js & React websites, Framer-grade motion systems, and technical SEO architecture.
2. **AI Workflows & Automation**: Autonomous workflows, webhook & API bridges, document extraction, and n8n / Make automation.
3. **Growth Operating Systems**: Centralized data hubs, executive dashboards, and cross-tool business intelligence.
4. **CRM & Lead Infrastructure**: Automated lead capture, dynamic enrichment, instant Slack/WhatsApp routing, and pipeline forecasting.
